method: Windows UI Automation against standalone application process

checks.name: Actual application launched; UIA connected to its HWND and PID
UIA InvokePattern returns to session page
UIA theme button changes, persists, and restores both themes
UIA ValuePattern inputs and InvokePattern processing produce correct decoded CSV
UIA cancellation while decoder page active removes partial output and restores idle
UIA repeated per-file batch after cancellation creates both outputs and exposes result action
UIA journal exposes actionable missing-input validation
Saved Light theme is restored by fresh application restart without environment override

limitations: Native file dialogs, physical keyboard/mouse and sustained scrolling not exercised
